title: Cody's Entity Cleanse
description: Automatically clears dropped items on a configurable timer with broadcast warnings.
body:
Tired of your server turning into a laggy mess of floating items nobody's gonna pick up? This mod handles that. Every 15 minutes it sweeps all dropped items and XP orbs across every dimension and clears them out. Players get warned at 5 minutes, 1 minute, and 10 seconds so nobody loses anything they actually wanted to keep.

The interval is fully configurable — edit config/codys_entity_cleanse.json or just use /setwipe <minutes> in-game and it saves automatically, no restart needed. There's also /wipe if you need to clear things right now, like when the server's chugging and you don't want to wait.

Commands (OP level 2+)

/setwipe — shows time until next wipe and current interval

/setwipe <1-1440> — changes the cycle and resets the timer

/wipe — triggers an immediate sweep

Server-side only, clients don't need anything installed. Requires Fabric API.

Built for 1.21.1 Fabric. Part of the Cody's mod collection.
